SELECT AVG(p.Score)
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

SELECT AVG(attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute;

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
  AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT fd.language
FROM foreign_data AS fd
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fd.language;

SELECT
    r.year,
    r.round,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location,
    c.country,
    c.lat,
    c.lng,
    c.alt,
    c.url AS circuit_url,
    r.url AS race_url
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Silverstone%'
ORDER BY r.date;

SELECT r.time
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 743
  AND d.forename = 'Bruce'
  AND d.surname = 'McLaren';

SELECT p.Id AS PostId, c.Text AS Comment
FROM posts AS p
JOIN comments AS c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Group differences on a five point Likert item';

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts AS p
JOIN comments AS c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Spain';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'rare'
  AND r.date = '2007-02-01';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) /
       NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule), 0) AS percent_compounds_with_triple_bond
FROM bond AS b
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS carcinogenic
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 9;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, Symptoms DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion = '2003'

SELECT driverRef

SELECT DISTINCT type

JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID

LEFT JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20

SELECT MAX(duration) AS longest_pit_stop_duration
FROM pitStops;

SELECT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
  AND t.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
  AND t.Price > 0

FROM superhero AS s

SELECT res.fastestLapTime
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

SELECT fd.type

JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid

SELECT a.account_id, a.date

WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY driverId
),
ranked_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM driver_points
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 90
)
SELECT SUM(r.wins) AS victories
FROM driverStandings AS r
JOIN ranked_driver AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId;

FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador'

  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS debt_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 'No loans'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(l.loan_id)
            THEN 'All loans are being paid'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(l.loan_id)
            THEN 'All loans have payment problems'
        ELSE 'Mixed payment status'
    END AS payment_status
FROM disp AS dp
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE dp.client_id = 992
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" IS NOT NULL

       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.format) AS legal_play_formats
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
 AND LOWER(l.status) = 'legal'
WHERE LOWER(c.rarity) = 'mythic'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate = (
      SELECT MIN(originalReleaseDate)
      FROM cards
      WHERE LOWER(rarity) = 'mythic'
        AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY c.originalReleaseDate;
